MiniWindTurbineDescription: A small wind turbine that slowly produces battery packs. Windy days accelerate the process.
LetterBody: Hi @,^^Dad and I have been tinkering a lot lately – we want to develop some new ways to harness natural energies! These little wind turbines won't power entire cities, but I'm sure they'll still come in handy. Mom's started selling them, too!^^- Maru
